plugin_yml:
name: AdventureRef
version: '1.0.0'
main: com.example.adventureref.AdventureRef
api-version: '1.21'
description: Reference plugin demonstrating Adventure API component messaging, MiniMessage, titles, sounds, action bars, and item meta.
authors: [StackNest]
commands:
  adventure-demo:
    description: Demo all Adventure API output methods.
    usage: /adventure-demo
    permission: adventureref.use
permissions:
  adventureref.use:
    description: Use the Adventure demo command.
    default: op
